title: Malaysia Health Ministry: incident did not involve encryption of main databases; detection date, not intrusion date
what_changed: The summary said the incident response team 'found the main databases were not encrypted'. The ministry's statement, carried by Bernama on 14 November, says the incident 'did not involve the encryption of the ministry's main databases', so the wording now says that. The ministry says it detected the incident on 12 November; the summary had said the intruder gained access on 12 November, and an unstated 12:00 occurred_at was removed. Added the ministry's work with NACSA and the Bernama source.
